Bavarian Championship: 15-year-old Hussain Besou joins the leaders
rubriker._rss_content: Six players share the lead with 4½ points after five rounds of the Bavarian Chess Championship in Gmund am Tegernsee. The leading group includes three Indian grandmasters and 15-year-old German IM Hussain Besou, who defeated former world junior champion Peter Acs in round five. Top seed Frederik Svane and third seed Alexander Donchenko are among the 31 players trailing the leaders by half a point. | Photo: Finn Engesser

rubriker.title: Chinese Rapid Championship: Ding Liren and Wang Hao exit in quarterfinals
rubriker._rss_content: Ding Liren and Wang Hao were both eliminated in the quarterfinals of the Chinese Rapid Championship, as three of the four rating favourites failed to reach the last four. Ding lost to Xiao Tong in a blitz tiebreaker, while Wang Hao was defeated by Xu Xiangyu. Yu Yangyi was the only higher-rated player to advance, joining Xiao, Xu and Lu Shanglei in the semifinals. | Photo: Chinese Chess Association

rubriker.title: Eugenio Torre: Asia's first grandmaster turns 75
rubriker._rss_content: In 1974, Eugenio Torre became the first Asian chess player to earn the grandmaster title. At his peak, the Filipino was among the world's elite and capable of beating any of the leading players. Torre also holds the record for the most appearances at Chess Olympiads, having competed in 23 editions. He was also one of the few people to maintain a close friendship with Bobby Fischer over many years. Today, Eugenio Torre celebrates his 75th birthday. | Photo: Reykjavik Open

rubriker._rss_content: FIDE har offentliggjort nye internasjonale ratingtall for november 2026. På verdensrankingen for langsjakk er det US Championship og Europacupen for klubblag som har ført til endringer i toppen. Carlsen (2823) har fortsatt 31 ratingpoeng ned til Nakamura (2792) på andreplass. Deretter følger Caruana (2783), Sindarov (2782), Abdusattorov (2772) og So (2771).
